hero.subtitle: Experience Bengaluru's Legendary Benne Dose and the Emotion That Holds Old Bengaluru Together.

about.title: The Enduring Legacy of Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room, affectionately known as CTR, is more than just an eatery; it's a legendary institution deeply woven into the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, Central Tiffin Room has spent over a century delighting generations with its iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a rich variety of South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites. Our cherished legacy, meticulously crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers and continued through Mr. Sanjeev Poojari to the current 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory.
about.paragraph2: At Central Tiffin Room, we proudly serve what many call 'Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose' – an emotion that encapsulates the spirit of Old Bengaluru with the essence of nostalgia in every bite. For over 100 years, CTR has cast its vintage charm, delivering the most delicious Benne Doses while steadfastly retaining the original taste and quality. This unwavering commitment, mirrored by the boundless love and support of our cherished patrons, is the true essence of Central Tiffin Room.
